about:
Head / Intermediate Bnuy / Undercarriage: the three body parts (owner, 2026-11-15). Owner: "Rather than doing Head and then Undercarriage, can we do it in threes? We do Head, then
Intermediate Bnuy, then Undercarriage. I agree with your boundary for the undercarriage, but I also
think we should have an intermediate one. See that dark line under his mouth that goes up through his
cheeks diagonally to his edge? That seems like where his head ends - he doesn't have a visible neck
but that crease is the closest thing."

ear_strip.about: owner-guided: a tiny, thin strip joining his ears along the top of his head, like his peets

checks.note: every approved part (peets, underfluff, ears) keeps its own label; must all be 0. ear_edge: pixels inside his body outline, touching an ear above its base, outside the ear polygon by ~1 px (the two approved outlines differ by a pixel there)
